title: Key moments at House UFO transparency hearing
description:
A House Oversight Committee task force held a hearing on Tuesday about transparency issues within the federal government regarding Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena, commonly known as UAPs or UFOs. Several witnesses testified about their encounters with UFOs and the need to improve protections for whistleblowers.

#news #ufo #congress
